messages.ko: 2주년일때 바로 오고싶었는데 잠들어 버렸다아ㅜㅠ 내가 벌써 트리플에스가 된지 2년이 되었다니 어엿한 2주년차 아이도루가 된거 같아서 뿌듯하기도 하고 시간 참 빠르구나 또 느낀것같아 우리 항상 하는 말이지만 2년동안 나도 육각단도 많이 성장한거같아서 너무 행복하고 우리가 같이 할 날이 앞으로 더 많다고 생각해서 너무 기대돼 항상 초심의 마음으로 열심히해야지 성장해야지 뭐든 완벽하진 않더라도 최선을 다해야지 이런 마음가짐으로 하고있지만 가끔은 나도 힘이 들거나 왜 내 뜻대로 되지 않을까 자책도 많이 했는데 내가 지금까지 힘들때 버티고 힘 나게 해준건 항상 웨이브 였던것같아서 너무 감사해
messages.en: I wanted to come right when it became my 2nd anniversary, but I fell asleepㅜㅠ. I can't believe it's already been 2 years since I became part of tripleS. I feel proud that I've become a proper idol celebrating my 2nd anniversary, and once again I realized how fast time flies. Like we always say, I think both I and the Hexagons have grown a lot over these past two years, so I'm really happy. Thinking that we still have so many more days together ahead of us makes me really excited. I always try to keep the same mindset I had at the beginning—to work hard, to keep growing, and to always do my best even if I can't do everything perfectly. But sometimes things get difficult for me too, and I blamed myself a lot wondering why things weren't going the way I wanted. Through all of that, I think the people who always gave me strength and helped me endure were WAVs, so I'm really grateful.
Please continue to take good care of me!
